values.note: Modern campground, 2027 on the booking site: 30-amp sites $34 weeknights, $37 Saturday; 50-amp sites $39 / $42. 2026: $32 (20/30-amp) and $37 (50-amp) in the DNR rates table and on the booking site. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry. (The separate rustic campground is $20.)

values.note: 143 sites in two loops (Loop 1: 75, Loop 2: 68), smaller in size and mostly shaded. Allowed equipment is 50 ft at 5 sites, 45 ft at 6, 40 ft at 52, 35 ft at 51, 30 ft at 23 and 25 ft at 6, so every site takes a 23-ft rig; pull-throughs at 79, 81, 96 and 98. A 20-site auxiliary overflow area is mapped separately.

values.note: Sanitation station (two lanes, potable water) near the modern campground entrance; the toilet/shower building is open for the whole reservable season. The laundry is in the beach house in the day-use area on Lake Michigamme.

note: Modern campground of Van Riper State Park, 35 miles west of Marquette off US-41: two loops beside the day-use area and buoyed sandy swim beach on Lake Michigamme, with sites smaller in size and mostly shaded. The park's separate Peshekee River rustic campground (39 sites) is in the woods nearby. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + rates table + MiDNRReservations: this entry is the MODERN campground (Loops 1 and 2). Count changed 147 -> 143, max length changed 85 -> 50 (all 143 take 25 ft+), pull-throughs new (4), electric 50 (confirmed; 36 sites), no sewer, showers/flush toilets/potable water/dump/camp store/laundry (new); fees changed 20/37 (rustic $20 mixed in, 2026) -> 34/42 (2027 booking site: 30-amp $34 weeknight to 50-amp $42 Saturday); reservable (confirmed) with reservation season May 15 - Oct 14 (confirmed, derived -> manual). No operating-season statement. Phone matches. Pin: on US-41 by the day-use lot, ~250 m NE of the modern loops (satellite) - close enough, but see flag. Note rewritten: the 'large sites handling rigs to ~85 ft' is contradicted ('sites are smaller in size'); field restatements dropped.
